POST: validate -> 400 re-render raw values with kit.errorSummary; valid -> state.commit via kit.recoverableSave (marked failure re-renders recoverableError:true, 500; other errors throw) -> h.redirect(await kit.nextTarget(request, page, scope)). backLink = hubPath(journey.journeyId) (real href — no '#' back link). export const routes = kit.pageRoutes(page, { get, post }). notes: 1:1 carry of inc-011 (page spec about-the-consignment.json, adversarially re-verified 2026-07-17). EXEMPLAR: the live-animals import-reason feature is a near-exact structural match — same obligation name (reasonForImport), same radios-with-hints shape, same service-backed oneOf validation; transpose features/import-reason/{page,controller,evaluation,template,copy}.js file-for-file (controller read live this session to pin the idiom: meta.collects, compose(oneOf(...)), render with reasonOptions + copy.reasonHints, kit.recoverableSave, kit.nextTarget, kit.pageRoutes). DECISIONS (headless): (1) options source = NEW sets/plant-products/services/reference/purposes.js created in THIS increment at its canonical §6.1 location, mirroring services/import-reason-purpose/index.js — chosen over inlining or adding pp-016 as a dep (MAPPING offered all three; dependsOn stays verbatim and pp-016's planner should treat purposes.js as already landed); (2) reasonForImport does NOT join policy.enforcedAtContinue — §3.3 names only countryOfOrigin (pp-018's call) and commoditySelection (pp-023's call) as candidates; (3) error copy = 'Select the main reason for importing the consignment' per the MAPPING brief and the spec's content-design signal (IPAFFS's own singleced variant echoes the H1; the legacy CHED-PP string 'Select the purpose of the consignment' is a recorded wiring gap — rejected); (4) hint mechanism = copy.reasonHints keyed by enum value, exemplar-identical; RE_CONFORMITY_CHECK deliberately hintless (trace-confirmed IPAFFS state; content-design question carried, not solved); (5) section insertion is order-aware because pp-018 (origin, spoke 1) is NOT a dependency and this increment may land first — canonical §2.3 order governs either way. RULINGS APPLIED: c-006 (normalised enum, never IPAFFS wire values — the 'import'-means-Re-entry trap is the sharpest reason), c-014 (legend-as-heading fix), c-018 (one canonical Joi-voice string), c-004 (GDS 'There is a problem'). FIXES-NOT-PORTED from the spec's nonStandardPatterns: legendless fieldset, duplicate re-entry-hint id, missing aria-describedby, vestigial govuk-radios--conditional, custom 'purpose' class, bold label overrides, href='#' back link. Check-answers row: features/check-answers does not exist until pp-038 — that increment owns the purpose card row (per §2.1 spoke-12 build order); no omission here. Mapper edit is set-owned files only (pp-008's real+stub store the whole tree; the DTO projection gains the field). No etag/optimistic concurrency: house standing deviation (whole-document last-write-wins, Open Q 3). Amend-variant 'Save and review'/'Save and return to hub' buttons: post-submission/amend surface, out of pass-1 scope — not built.
openQuestions: Open Q 5 (carried from the spec): only 'Internal market' was ever chosen in any trace; 'For import re-conformity check' is exercised by NO trace and NO legacy test — its downstream behaviour in IPAFFS is unknown. Built here as a plain enum value with no branching; if product later learns it routes differently, that is new scope.

Cross-field rule (spec behaviours, CHED-P-confirmed only): does amending country-of-origin clear the purpose answer? Not built for CHED-PP pass 1 (no admissible CHED-PP evidence); flag to SME — if real it becomes an applyTo/wipe relationship between origin and purpose.
